mapper.select: SELECT wsnm AS "流域全称", COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(alias_name),''), wsnm) AS "流域简称", river_name AS "所在水系", wsarea AS "流域面积km2", wsperi AS "流域周长km", wsslp AS "流域坡度", outlet_elv AS "沟口高程m", max_elv AS "最高点高程m", jizhen_count AS "集镇个数", village_count AS "防治村个数", gully_count AS "山洪沟道条数" FROM sh_map_watershed WHERE wscd = #{wscd}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "防治对象总数", COALESCE(SUM(pcount),0) AS "受威胁总人口", COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(town_name),'')) AS "涉及乡镇数" FROM sh_survey_object WHERE wscd = #{wscd}
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ftp),''),'未分类') AS "类型", COUNT(*) AS "数量", COALESCE(SUM(pcount),0) AS "受威胁人口" FROM sh_survey_object WHERE wscd = #{wscd} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(town_name),''),'未知') AS "乡镇", COALESCE(MAX(county_name),'') AS "县区", COUNT(*) AS "防治对象数", COALESCE(SUM(pcount),0) AS "受威胁人口" FROM sh_survey_object WHERE wscd = #{wscd} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT fnm AS "对象名称", COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ftp),''),'未分类') AS "类型", pcount AS "受威胁人口", rvnm AS "所在河流", town_name AS "所在乡镇" FROM sh_survey_object WHERE wscd = #{wscd} AND pcount > 0 ORDER BY pcount DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT flag AS "风险隐患要素", COUNT(*) AS "防治对象数", string_agg(fnm, '、' ORDER BY pcount DESC) AS "涉及对象" FROM (SELECT fnm, pcount, UNNEST(risk_flags) AS flag FROM sh_survey_object WHERE wscd = #{wscd} AND risk_flags IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT name AS "点位名称", stype AS "类型", CASE WHEN width ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (width)::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "宽度m", CASE WHEN deep ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (deep)::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "深度m", dmform AS "断面形式", CASE WHEN zsmj ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (zsmj)::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "占压面积" FROM sh_survey_gully WHERE wscd = #{wscd} ORDER BY name LIMIT 30
SELECT hz_type AS "隐患类型", COUNT(*) AS "处数" FROM sh_map_hazard_point WHERE wscd = #{wscd} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT name AS "隐患点名称", hz_type AS "隐患类型", fnm AS "关联防治对象" FROM sh_map_hazard_point WHERE wscd = #{wscd} ORDER BY hz_type, name LIMIT 30

SELECT h.pid AS "编码", h.name AS "名称", h.hz_type AS "隐患类型", h.fnm AS "关联防治对象" FROM sh_map_hazard_point h WHERE h.wscd = #{wscd} AND (h.hz_type LIKE '%桥%' OR h.hz_type LIKE '%涵%') ORDER BY h.name LIMIT 20

SELECT name AS "名称", stype AS "类型", CASE WHEN obstruction_area_ratio ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (obstruction_area_ratio)::numeric ELSE NULL END AS "阻水比R1", backwater_objname AS "壅水影响对象", overflow_objname AS "漫流影响对象", burst_objname AS "溃决影响对象" FROM sh_survey_road WHERE wscd = #{wscd} ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30
SELECT obj_type AS "防护对象类型", COUNT(*) AS "处数", COALESCE(SUM(pcount),0) AS "人口" FROM sh_map_prevention_area WHERE wscd = #{wscd} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT MAX(wsnm) AS "流域全称", MAX(alias_name) AS "流域别名", COUNT(*) AS "防治对象数", COALESCE(SUM(pcount),0) AS "涉及人口", SUM(CASE WHEN risk_flags IS NOT NULL AND array_length(risk_flags,1) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "有风险隐患对象数" FROM sh_survey_object WHERE wscd = #{wscd}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sh_map_watershed) AS "小流域数", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sh_survey_object) AS "防治对象数", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(wscd,'')) FROM sh_survey_object) AS "涉及流域数", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pcount),0) FROM sh_survey_object) AS "涉及人口"

SELECT stype AS "类型", COUNT(*) AS "数量", ROUND(AVG(r1),2) AS "平均R1", MAX(r1) AS "最大R1", SUM(CASE WHEN r1 <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "低阻水", SUM(CASE WHEN r1 > 10 AND r1 <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "中阻水", SUM(CASE WHEN r1 > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "高阻水", SUM(CASE WHEN r1 > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "极端阻水" FROM (SELECT stype, CASE WHEN obstruction_area_ratio ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (obstruction_area_ratio)::numeric ELSE NULL END AS r1 FROM sh_survey_road) t GROUP BY stype

SELECT name AS "名称", code AS "编码", stype AS "类型", obstruction_area_ratio AS "阻水比R1", backwater_objname AS "壅水影响对象", overflow_objname AS "漫流影响对象" FROM (SELECT name, code, stype, obstruction_area_ratio, backwater_objname, overflow_objname, CASE WHEN obstruction_area_ratio ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (obstruction_area_ratio)::numeric ELSE NULL END AS r1 FROM sh_survey_road) t WHERE r1 > 30 ORDER BY r1 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "占地点位数", COALESCE(SUM(z),0) AS "总占压面积", SUM(CASE WHEN z > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "严重占压数", COALESCE(MAX(z),0) AS "最大占压面积" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN zsmj ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN (zsmj)::numeric ELSE NULL END AS z FROM sh_survey_gully) t

SELECT w.wscd AS "wscd", COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.alias_name),''), w.wsnm) AS "wsnm", COUNT(o.id) AS "对象数", COALESCE(SUM(o.pcount),0) AS "人口" FROM sh_map_watershed w LEFT JOIN sh_survey_object o ON o.wscd = w.wscd GROUP BY w.wscd, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC
SELECT wsnm, alias_name FROM sh_map_watershed WHERE wscd = #{wscd} LIMIT 1
SELECT wscd, wsnm, alias_name FROM sh_map_watershed
SELECT DISTINCT wscd, wsnm, alias_name FROM sh_map_watershed ORDER BY wsnm LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: GROUP BY wscd, wsnm, alias_name ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(wsnm,'')) DESC LIMIT 8
mapper.select: SELECT wscd, wsnm, alias_name FROM sh_map_watershed WHERE COALESCE(wsnm,'') <> '' AND #{key} LIKE CONCAT('%', wsnm, '%')
